transparency.note: Generated partial alpha is preserved exactly. Any thresholding, edge cleanup and hidden-RGB removal are lead-owned assembly work.

references.role: primary runtime identity, proportions, costume, colors and headings
supporting armor and rear/profile anatomy detail
retro pixel style only; labels, weapons and magic excluded

review.method: Inspected built-in output and byte-identical saved original using view_image; read-only dimensions, alpha counts and SHA256 verification.
observations: 32 complete sprites arranged as 8 columns by 4 rows, with clear transparent spacing and no observed crop or overlap.
All rows follow front, front-right, right profile, back-right, back, back-left, left profile, front-left sequence.
Broad purple troll identity, ivory horns and tusks, black mane, dark gold-edged armor, belt and maroon cloth tabs remain recognizable across all headings.
Rising row has raised arms and folded knees/feet; descending row lowers arms and unfolds legs beneath the body, producing visibly different silhouettes.
Landing is lower and wider than anticipation with deeper visible knee/hip flexion, especially in front and profile views.
Head size appears broadly consistent across poses at source scale; no gross enlarged-head crouch or whole-body squash was observed.
Hands are empty. No bow, staff, weapon, magic, ground shadow, labels or environment were observed.
limitations_and_ambiguities: Heavy hip armor and rear cloth partly hide knee articulation in rear views; the depth difference between anticipation and landing is subtler from directly behind.
Some far hands are naturally occluded by the broad torso in profile/rear-quarter poses.
Exact one-third neutral-standing head proportion and common anatomical lengths have not been measured at native game size.
Generated alpha contains extensive partial coverage and occasional colored edge fringe; original is untouched for lead-owned deterministic cleanup.
These are four authored action keys, not a complete timed animation cycle.
